outcome: Severe neonatal morbidities (intraventricular hemorrhages grade 3-4, cystic periventricular leukomalacia, retinopathy of prematurity needing treatment, bronchopulmonary dysplasia)
Other morbidities (respiratory distress, treated patent ductus arteriosus, necrotizing enterocolitis)
cohort: 76,360 very preterm singleton infants without malformations born between 24 to 31 weeks gestation with birth weights less than 1500 g, including 3,280 infants of diabetic mothers
finding: After adjusting for confounders, maternal diabetes was not associated with an increased risk of in-hospital mortality or severe morbidity in very preterm infants with a birth weight of fewer than 1500 g.
mod_finding: Mothers with diabetes had more deliveries by cesarean delivery than mothers without diabetes.
